items.question: What is the minimum age to apply for a commercial fishing licence in Abu Dhabi?
items.gold: The applicant must be at least 18 years old.
items.fact: Abu Dhabi commercial fishing licence requires applicants at least 18 years old.

items.question: How often can the Bohoor fishing permit in Abu Dhabi be renewed?
items.gold: It can be renewed every 4 years.
items.fact: Bohoor permit in Abu Dhabi renewable every four years.
